newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets rest, ready for New Year.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets rest, ready for New Year.

text.p: Cotton prices across Europe were largely unchanged in thin pre-holiday activity with only a modest improvement in New York futures to tempt traders, industry sources said.
Demand was limited, focussing on upland styles which remain in tight supply, and sellers were still playing hard-to-get.
Most commentators believe the market will move higher in the New Year as underlying demand, most notably from the yarn sector, appears increasingly solid.
